verdict.rationale: Cua documents an SDK in Python, TypeScript and Rust for creating and driving computers from your own code (cua-docs-7). It runs on Docker/Podman, QEMU or Lume, or connects to remote cua-spacesd hosts by address and token (cua-docs-8, cua-docs-9), and streams sessions back so your users can watch or take over (cua-docs-11, cua-docs-26), which is what embedding device control in an app requires. One hands-on report of an older version failing to connect to the Computer API Server WebSocket (cua-comm-1) points to reliability concerns, not a missing capability. Missing for 10: detailed API reference evidence (no OpenAPI spec found per cua-probe-3), independent hands-on confirmation of successful SDK embedding, and evidence that the connection problems seen in older versions are resolved.
